title: Notebooks: let the engine do the work
objectives: Use Spark SQL and PySpark cells in a Fabric notebook on the same tables
Say why collect() and toPandas() on a whole table can fail
Aggregate in the query so only the answer comes back

exercises.prompt: Revenue per store region from complete orders: region, orders (how many) and revenue, largest revenue first. Aggregate in the query, so four rows come back.
hints: The starter brings back every order. Which three columns does the question ask for?
Join orders to stores on store_id for the region, keep status = 'complete', then GROUP BY region with count(*) and sum(amount).
